session_summary: The session clarified that the project is pivoting toward a file-first CLI/protocol workflow, with transcript extraction and OSS packaging prioritized over web UI work.
requested_next_action: Create README, protocol documentation, JSON Schema, and an example handoff demonstrating rejected options.

items.content: The main product surface for v1 is the local file-first CLI workflow around task.ledger.json.
items.rationale: The human explicitly said the web app can remain but should not be the focus for v1.

items.content: Do not build a VS Code extension in v1.
items.rationale: The first release should prove the local file protocol and CLI workflow before editor integrations.
There is no hosted user model in this phase.

items.content: The repository already contains a Next app, Supabase migration, domain model, handoff generator, and initial CLI commands.
Transcript extraction should write candidates.json, and a separate command should commit reviewed candidates as provisional state.
items.rationale: Separating extraction from commit allows human review by editing the candidates file.

items.content: Create README, protocol documentation, JSON Schema, and an example handoff demonstrating rejected options.
